archetypes.name: dyn-cursor-routing
archetypes.rationale: Cursor defaults and explicit per-slot overrides now share one resolution path across multiple launch surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect static and dynamic review manifest construction, CI recovery, and review-fix coder launches. Verify every default Cursor row records composer-2.5 as resolved_model, explicit cursor_model overrides remain launch-effective, and no auto producer remains. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
